portal_proposer.configuration: PortalLatticeConfig defaults from retained dual-family v3

training.head: shared MLP candidate scorer plus mean/max/min permutation-invariant set summary and explicit NONE head
training.loss: multi-positive listwise target likelihood with explicit NONE

baselines.structure_rank: Unchanged portal proposal_score order; always COMMIT top one.

candidate_local_clip_dino.score: mean(local CLIP target margin, local DINO target margin)

baselines.target_support_ray: Unchanged SupportFieldConfig and SupportRayConfig over the dual-family portal boxes.

episode_contract.correct_target: Frozen portal-set members are positive candidates. If the proposer supplies none, NONE is the only legal proposal-conditional output and the episode remains a Top-K miss.
episode_contract.wrong_target: Pair each query with every other entity in its split; all candidates are negative and NONE is the only legal output.
episode_contract.test_isolation: Test entities, references, truth, features, and metrics cannot affect training normalization, checkpoint selection, or baseline selection.

baseline_selection: On Development choose the baseline lexicographically by Top-1 truth recall, Top-3 truth recall, then lower non-NONE false-accept rate; carry that one baseline name unchanged to test.
promotion_gate: On the six building-disjoint test entities, PB1 must retain Top-3 at least as often as the selected strongest baseline and either improve Top-1 by at least one building or reduce wrong portal COMMIT by at least 50 percent. Otherwise stop embedding/fusion tuning and change the information source or representation.
claim_boundary: Curated public-image target-to-functional-portal binding only. The test is algorithm-fresh for PB1 but its portal pixels were previously used for proposer confirmation. No public-access, traversability, active motion, tracking, guidance, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety claim.
